fields.FIR_Description: During the morning of 2025-04-03, around 10:05, the complainant paid Rs. 40,000 to a person who promised a job placement, but no appointment order was provided and calls went unanswered, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-04-05. The complaint was lodged by Yogesh Raj (9000000359). Padmini Sri (9000000119) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. A person named Udhay Anand, associated with the number 9000000125, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The account reference SYN-ACC-100070 was noted in connection with the payment.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly paid a fee for a job that was never provided.
